'''''Executor Executes''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]]<ref name="Celestia Galactica Photografica" /> created after [[104 ABY]]<ref name="Date" /> that depicted the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] and eight [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] in an attack on an artificial ring surrounding an [[Color/Legends|orange]] celestial body. The painting also included two more celestial bodies in the background.<ref name="Celestia Galactica Photografica" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Executor Executes'' appeared in "[[Celestia Galactica Photografica]]," a collection of [[in-universe]] illustrations by [[Ryan Church]] collected in ''[[Star Wars: Visionaries]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Graphic novel|graphic novel]] edited by [[Jeremy Barlow]] and published in [[2005]].<ref name="Celestia Galactica Photografica" />
